\begin{abstract}
We describe a synthetic sample of 60 planets: the summary statistics of radius and orbital period, the distribution of radii, and the radius--period plane. The median radius is 2.515 Earth radii; most planets lie between 2 and 3 Earth radii, and 7 lie between 1.5 and 2. Radius and period are weakly and negatively associated (Spearman's rank correlation $-0.1423$). The study is descriptive and makes no causal claim.
\end{abstract}
